timing.method: First logged future-date call per ticker/date/type; strict five-session daily-close high/low; ±2 sessions; two later closed bars confirm. One turn credits one call, earliest-issued first; historical-audit and forward cohorts are matched and covered independently (the combined summary uses one global matching). Error = called session minus actual session (negative = early).
timing.limitations: Daily-close turns are not intraday highs/lows or tradeable confirmation signals. Historical audit uses a rule chosen after those data; it is not unseen validation. Timing hits do not measure net trading profitability. Method tags describe blended calls, not standalone method performance.
timing.promotion: No weight changes. Require predeclared standalone/control comparisons on unseen sessions, adequate independent samples, and a separate cost/slippage/drawdown test.
